Welcome Fredrik!

Let us introduce the newest addition to the editorial team, Fredrik Johansson, at Bidders Highway. Fredrik also works at Bilsport & MC, the motoring enthusiasts' own insurance company.
Bidders HighwayMarch 31, 2023 12:30
Hi!

Time to introduce myself. My name is Fredrik, and probably the world's oldest thirty-two-year-old. Growing up in a garage among buses and taxis, I realised early on that vehicles are a lifestyle. My first car came at the age of ten, and I'd have to think long and hard to count how many have passed through my hands since.

In later years, my focus has been on saving cars from their fate — a car covered in algae or moss gets my pulse racing! The spontaneous purchases of tractors, bad Saabs, or Tjorven vans, along with my hobby tinkering for practical needs, are rarely enough. Nor is the time…

Going forward, I'll be sharing articles related to owning a hobby car or hobby motorcycle, as well as giving a glimpse into the everyday life of a car enthusiast.

See you around!
